world.title: Iran's IRGC claims self-imposed 2,000-km ballistic missile range limit 'has been lifted'
world.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has declared that it has lifted a self-imposed limit on the range of its ballistic missiles, previously set at 2,000 kilometers (1,200 miles). This decision may enable Iran to develop missiles with longer ranges, potentially altering the regional security landscape and impacting international relations regarding missile proliferation and defense strategies.

world.title: Magnitude 5.7 earthquake hits central Japan, dozens injured
world.summary: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck central Japan early Sunday, leading authorities to implement emergency response measures. The tremor occurred at 1:04 AM local time and resulted in dozens of injuries, according to Japanese media reports. The earthquake's impact prompted a swift response from local officials to assess damage and provide assistance to affected residents.

world.title: 'Extortion at the highest level': Trump directs DOJ to investigate Democratic lawmakers
world.summary: US President Donald Trump has instructed the Department of Justice (DOJ) to conduct an immediate investigation into Democratic lawmakers. He alleges that these lawmakers have threatened senior administration officials, Republican donors, and political supporters. Trump's directive highlights his ongoing tensions with the Democratic Party and raises concerns about the politicization of the DOJ in response to these accusations.

business.title: Wars May Spur Faster Electrification
business.summary: COP31 aims to accelerate global electrification amid rising fossil fuel prices due to conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East. These wars have led to increased electric vehicle sales as consumers seek alternatives to traditional fuels. Participants at COP31 are advocating for greater electricity use and exploring other power generation sources to mitigate the impact of fuel inflation.

business.title: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng steps down, Justin Yek named new finance chief
business.summary: Binance's finance chief, Kaiser Ng, is stepping down to pursue another opportunity, the company announced. This change comes shortly after hackers stole $6.3 billion from the cryptocurrency exchange in a significant breach. Justin Yek has been appointed as the new finance chief. Binance remains the largest cryptocurrency exchange globally, despite the recent security incident.

business.title: India Car Sales Hit Record 5.24 Lakh in October 2026; Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai and Kia Set All-Time Highs
business.summary: India's car sales reached a record 524,226 units in October 2026, marking a 12.3% increase year-on-year. Major manufacturers, including Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai, and Kia, reported all-time high monthly dispatches. Maruti Suzuki led the sales with 212,384 passenger vehicles, up from 176,318 units in October 2025, reflecting a 20.5% year-on-year growth.

technology.title: Cursor vs VS Code Java Setup: 13 Steps, 60 Min [2026]
technology.summary: The article outlines a 13-step process to set up JDK 25, Maven, and Spring Boot 4.1.2 in Cursor and VS Code, taking approximately 60 minutes. It highlights challenges with Java integration, including separate extensions for the language server, debugger, Maven, and test runner. Additionally, it emphasizes the importance of shared configuration, gap checks, and a CI gate in the setup.

technology.title: Sony MDR-3R wired headphones launched and it brings back the nostaliga from 1979
technology.summary: Sony has launched the MDR-3R wired headphones, reviving its classic 1979 design originally introduced with the first Walkman. The new model features USB-C connectivity and 23mm drivers, maintaining the nostalgic aesthetic while updating the technology. The MDR-3R aims to appeal to both longtime fans and new users, blending retro style with modern functionality in audio equipment.

technology.title: 5 iPhone Security Settings You Should Change To Protect Your Data
technology.summary: To enhance data security on your iPhone, consider changing five key settings. These adjustments help protect personal information from unauthorized access. Apple provides various security features in iOS, which are essential for safeguarding sensitive data. Taking a few minutes to configure these settings can significantly reduce the risk of data breaches and ensure better privacy for users.

sports.title: 'Of course there is tension' - how Leclerc sees Ferrari Mexico fallout
sports.summary: Charles Leclerc acknowledged the "tension" between him and teammate Lewis Hamilton following Ferrari's issues at the Mexican Grand Prix. In a recent meeting, he addressed the challenges of ensuring both drivers can race competitively without jeopardizing the team's overall performance. Leclerc's comments come amid ongoing scrutiny of Ferrari's strategies and the dynamics between its drivers.

sports.title: Mourinho: “This Real Madrid is united and very promising”
sports.summary: Real Madrid coach José Mourinho praised his team's performance following a 3-0 victory over Valencia at Mestalla. He highlighted the players' defensive efforts, stating that the credit belongs to them. Mourinho expressed confidence in the team's unity and potential, emphasizing that their collective work contributed significantly to the win, showcasing a promising future for the squad.

sports.title: Why Fernando Alonso was disappointed despite Brazil GP qualifying heroics
sports.summary: Fernando Alonso expressed disappointment despite achieving his best qualifying result of the season at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, reaching Q3 for the first time. He acknowledged that while he capitalized on challenging conditions due to heavy rain, he felt there was more potential to unlock. Alonso's performance showcased his skill, yet he remained critical of the overall outcome.

health.title: Beauty at Face Value
health.summary: A new beauty trend emphasizes a natural appearance, aiming for a look that suggests no cosmetic procedures have been performed. This "beauty flex" values fresh, luminous skin without the use of Botox, fillers, or skin boosters. The goal is to achieve an aesthetic that appears effortless, making it difficult for others to identify any enhancements.

health.title: Simple bedtime change may help some individuals lose weight, study finds
health.summary: A clinical trial by NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing found that moving bedtime one hour earlier resulted in weight loss among adults with prediabetes. The study indicated that earlier sleep onset was associated with greater weight loss, even without an increase in total sleep duration. This suggests that simple bedtime adjustments may benefit individuals struggling with weight management.

health.title: Obsession explained: What is heightmaxxing? New trend pushing teenagers to take cancer drugs to get taller? Why?
health.summary: The 'heightmaxxing' trend is leading some teenagers to seek erdafitinib, a cancer drug, to increase their height. This practice is driven by social media and concerns over physical appearance. However, research supporting its effectiveness involved only two children undergoing cancer treatment, and the drug is not approved for height enhancement, raising safety and ethical concerns.

science.title: Day' from Earth, 25.9 Billion km Away — BigGo Finance
science.summary: NASA's Voyager 1, launched in 1977, is set to make history on November 18 by becoming the first human-made object to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth, approximately 25.9 billion kilometers. This milestone highlights the probe's long journey through space, continuing to send valuable data back to Earth, despite being far beyond the solar system's boundaries.

science.title: Scientists say accelerating 1998 KY26 too warm for 'dark' comet
science.summary: Asteroid 1998 KY26 is exhibiting unpredictable acceleration, prompting scientists to reevaluate its classification. Initially considered a "dark" comet due to potential hidden gas jets affecting its trajectory, recent research indicates that its behavior does not align with typical comet characteristics. This discovery challenges existing knowledge about the asteroid, suggesting it may not fit conventional definitions of either asteroids or comets.

science.title: Is the Male Species Really Facing Extinction? Could the Evolution of the Y Chromosome Transform Humanity's Future?
science.summary: Research on genetic changes and the evolutionary history of the Y chromosome raises questions about the future of human reproduction. Some mammals reproduce without a conventional Y chromosome, prompting discussions about potential impacts on the male population. This exploration highlights the complexities of genetics and evolution, suggesting that the fate of males may be influenced by ongoing biological transformations.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 8, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 8, 2026, Pisces should focus on recognizing the positive developments in their life rather than fixating on perceived deficiencies. The horoscope emphasizes the importance of clarity regarding personal desires, suggesting that this awareness can lead to the creation of something meaningful and lasting. Overall, the day encourages mindfulness and appreciation of current opportunities.

entertainment.title: Shah Rukh Khan reveals how father's death changed his sister's life, says his humour and flamboyance hide a deep sadness
entertainment.summary: Shah Rukh Khan discussed the impact of his father's death on his sister's life, revealing that while he often presents a humorous and flamboyant exterior, it conceals a profound sadness. He emphasized the emotional depth behind his public persona, highlighting how personal loss can shape one's character and experiences, affecting not only individuals but their families as well.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 8, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aries individuals are encouraged to embrace their personal power on November 8, 2026. The horoscope suggests that recent choices reflect a deep understanding of their current situation. This is a time for Aries to explore new opportunities and venture into the unknown, as their inner strength and confidence are aligned with their aspirations. Embracing this energy is key.
